recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-22845 unless a future Pharmacy or FHIR-I decision changes the resource naming again.
issue_request: FHIR-22845 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the Resource identity consistency section. It asked to correct the misspelled link text MedicationSUsage to MedicationUsage in the sentence giving MedicationRequest and MedicationUsage as examples of medication orders.
initial_application: Commit c5eb99e330797fe2b7b44250492d1c5c1675fe16, titled "MedicationSUsage -> MedicationUsage", changed source/resource/resource-notes.xml from MedicationSUsage to MedicationUsage and referenced FHIR-22845. The Jira comment also identifies HL7/fhir pull request 1934 as the submitted fix.
additional_context: The typo arose in the naming context created by FHIR-19469, which renamed MedicationStatement to MedicationUsage for R5. Later, FHIR-38682 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and changed the resource name back to MedicationStatement while keeping the remaining resource changes. Commit b2032629f28b8d31b9a67b46170dde873398fb0d applied that later rename in source/fhir.ini and source/resource/resource-notes.xml, so the current MedicationStatement wording is expected.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/resource/resource-notes.xml uses MedicationStatement with a medicationstatement.html link and has no MedicationSUsage typo, and source/fhir.ini shows Resource and MedicationStatement as active build-scope entries.

related_jiras.note: Renamed MedicationStatement to MedicationUsage, creating the naming context in which the FHIR-22845 typo appeared.
Renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement and explains the current source wording.
